svg.text: This message shows that your installation appears to be working correctly.

svg.text: To generate this message, Docker took the following steps:

text.font-family: Ubuntu Mono, Cascadia Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 1. The Docker client contacted the Docker daemon.

text.font-family: Ubuntu Mono, Cascadia Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 2. The Docker daemon pulled the "hello-world" image from the Docker Hub.

text.font-family: Ubuntu Mono, Cascadia Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 3. The Docker daemon created a new container from that image.

text.font-family: Ubuntu Mono, Cascadia Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 4. The Docker daemon streamed that output to the Docker client.
